message.Title: Generally Available: Application Gateway for Containers – Service Mesh integration with Istio

Body.Content:
Application Gateway for Containers service mesh integration with Istio is now generally available. This capability simplifies secure north-south traffic into workloads running in an Istio service mesh by automating mutual TLS (mTLS) connectivity between Application Gateway for Containers and mesh-enabled services.  

With general availability, customers can use this integration with both upstream open-source Istio and the Istio-based service mesh add-on for Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). This gives teams flexibility to adopt a managed AKS experience while using Application Gateway for Containers as their ingress path for services inside and outside the mesh.  

  • Single ingress solution: Route traffic to services both inside and outside the mesh through one gateway.  
  • Reduced operational overhead: Simplify ingress configuration and avoid repetitive mTLS definitions.  
  • Managed certificate lifecycle: Automate certificate trust and rotation for secure communication with mesh workloads.  
  • Flexible deployment options: Support both upstream Istio and the AKS Istio-based service mesh add-on.  

Learn more:  

  • Application Gateway for Containers + Istio service mesh  
  • Application Gateway for Containers overview  
  • Original public preview announcement
